description: Actual generation data used in the machine learning-based hydropower plant assessment is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Tianyi Luo, Yan Cheng. Actual generation data used in the machine learning-based hydropower plant assessment that supports the findings of the study titled "A framework to assess multi-hazard climate risk for power generation projects from publicly accessible sources" to Communications Earth & Environment. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 23369 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
